# Kotoba API Registry

Curated catalog of API contracts, protocol specifications, API clients and implementations owned by kotoba-lang.

- Catalog: ./index.json
- Full consumption and verification contract: ./llms-full.txt
- Ownership: ./docs/adr/0001-api-registry-ownership.md
- Entry schema: ./schemas/entry.schema.json
- Source repository remains authoritative; index membership grants no execution rights.
